acceptanceCriteria: Either map-key table cases are extracted as claims, or the refusal names the supported table shapes; a test covers a map-keyed table.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the Beamfall PTR orientation run (beamfall/core#32). OCM extracts a Go test case as a claim only from a slice-table `name:` field or a `t.Run("...")` literal. A `map[string]struct{...}` table, a common Go idiom, yields `claim-selector-out-of-range` for every case, and the change had to rewrite its tests as slice tables before linking worked. The refusal does not say which table shapes are supported.
title: ocm: Go table cases keyed by map key are not extracted as claims, so adopter tests cannot anchor requirements
